rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a high-quality expanded/early hatching blastocyst with strong ICM and cohesive TE, consistent with the reported 4AA image/lab description. Minor overreach in discussing possible partial collapse and 5AA vs 4AA nuance from a single image.
Comprehensively integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, first-cycle status, endometriosis, and smoking with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: excellent morphology and favorable age/endometrium improve prognosis, while smoking and endometriosis temper expectations. Probability estimate is well supported.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, no bed rest, smoking cessation, cautious approach to further workup after repeated failures. Slightly speculative areas include broad comments on pretreatment suppression and implantation/live birth ranges.
Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, smoking cessation, luteal support adherence, lifestyle guidance, and escalation pathway if repeated failures occur.
